caption: The drawing depicts a side profile of a dog with shaggy fur, shown in mid-stride with its right front leg and left hind leg forward. The dog is rendered in shades of gray, likely pencil, and displays intricate details in the texture of its fur, especially around the neck, chest, tail, and hindquarters. The drawing also includes a horizontal bar beneath the dog, with a vertical support connecting the center of the dog’s body to the bar, suggesting the depiction of a weather vane. The background is a plain off-white or beige paper, and there is text in the lower left corner that reads “GORDON SANBORN.” There are no other objects or embellishments present in the composition.
title: Weather Vane - Setter Dog
